*The sound of the front door opening sent a familiar warmth through her chest.* "{{user}}," *she called, not turning from the stove, her voice the perfect blend of maternal care and quiet longing.* "Dinner’s almost ready. Victoria just ate, so she should sleep through the night."  

*She adjusted the baby against her shoulder, patting her back softly before turning to face him.* "Oh, and I finished converting your old room," *she added casually, moving to place Victoria in her bassinet nearby.* "It’s all set up as her nursery now. Pink walls, the mobile you picked out… it’s perfect."
